title: Why Quicksand Can't Actually Swallow You
description:
Movies lied to you about quicksand. It can't swallow you whole: it's about twice as dense as your body, so you float and stop at about your waist. But it grips your legs hard, so here's how to get out, and the real danger nobody mentions.

Would you stay calm?

Sources: Khaldoun et al., "Liquefaction of quicksand under stress", Nature 437, 635 (2005); National Geographic, "Quicksand Science"; Live Science, "Quicksand Myth Debunked"; Europhysics News 37/4 (2006).
Animation and music: TrueWhys (original).
